retro:
# Retrospective: PR 12870

## Worked
Fresh reviewers received equivalent public-only history and pinned revisions. Both chose proportionate source-only scope for a one-line documentation follow-up. No runtime or desktop fixture was needed. Both final reports existed before synthesis. Successful/failed raw transport and source research were retained.

## Process issues and corrections
- Coordinator used Team.launch, which does not exist. No lifecycle action occurred in that failed call. Inspected the method definition, then used Team.start for owned roles only. Future launcher calls must use source-verified method names.
- Opus reports an initial 85-line filename/count listing. It was not a policy/source read, but future assignments should bound every tool response, not only policy/source. Native history retained. No automatic oversized native persistence is established from this incident.
- Opus convention scan failed decoding a binary manual file. Retained original stdout/stderr/exit, corrected Markdown-only scan retained separately. Neither scan is required for final public claims. Inspect file type before decoding; gate producers immediately.
- One source scan exit receipt has the text exit=0 rather than a bare code. Do not use it to establish runtime validation. Future receipts should use a consistent structured status.
- Claude startup auto-memory held process reminders only. No substantive prior-PR content was reported; do not claim absence of memory. Prefer a supported verified session-local no-memory control when available, preserve all native history and never guess unsupported flags.

## Evidence boundary
No runtime tests or probes, no host service/configuration/account access and no repository assertions executed. Source scans and API decoding were read-only research. Public conclusions retain only the pinned manual/menu changes and original-to-head comparison; no archive-wide absence, whole-suite or runtime success claim.

## Resources
No isolated runtime or desktop slots were allocated. Technical agents completed in owned Team 5 panes. Preserve native sessions and artifacts. No process-pattern cleanup or upstream action.

## Tools
No confirmed Omadev issue. No requested tool feature is necessary to complete this documentation-only review. Keep public follow-up proportionate and preserve the exact editorial snapshot.
